mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.status = 1
AND g.category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(i.goods_id) AS goodsCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS stockQty, NULL AS costPrice, COALESCE(SUM(i.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * g.retail_price), 0) AS retailValue, NULL AS stockStatus FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE g.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY costAmount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.status = 1
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND (COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower OR (g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper))

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OVERSTOCK' END AS alertType, COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS stockQty, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN g.safety_stock_lower - COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) - g.safety_stock_upper ELSE 0 END AS gapQty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN CEIL(g.safety_stock_lower * #{suggestK} + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ir.change_qty) / #{avgDays} FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.goods_id = g.id AND ir.record_type = 'SALE_OUT' AND ir.operate_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{avgDays} DAY)), 0) * #{leadDays} - COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(poi.quantity - poi.received_qty) FROM purchase_order_item poi JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE poi.goods_id = g.id AND po.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')), 0)) ELSE NULL END AS suggestQty, i.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE g.status = 1
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND (COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower OR (g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper))
ORDER BY gapQty DESC, g.id

SELECT ir.record_type AS recordType, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(ir.change_qty), 0) AS changeQty, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(ir.change_qty) * ir.unit_cost), 0) AS amount FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.operate_time >= #{beginTime} AND ir.operate_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY ir.record_type ORDER BY ir.record_type

SELECT ir.goods_id AS goodsId, COALESCE(SUM(ir.change_qty * ir.unit_cost), 0) AS flowAmount FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.operate_time >= #{beginTime} AND ir.operate_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY ir.goods_id

SELECT soi.goods_id AS goodsId, COALESCE(SUM(soi.cost_amount), 0) AS saleCostAmount FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND soi.goods_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY soi.goods_id

SELECT roi.goods_id AS goodsId, COALESCE(SUM(roi.cost_amount), 0) AS returnCostAmount FROM return_order_item roi JOIN return_order ro ON ro.id = roi.return_id WHERE ro.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND roi.goods_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY roi.goods_id

SELECT l.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, l.biz_type AS bizType, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS lossQty, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lossAmount FROM loss_order l JOIN goods g ON g.id = l.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE l.status = 'AUDITED' AND l.audit_time >= #{beginTime} AND l.audit_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY l.goods_id, g.name, c.name, l.biz_type

SELECT sci.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, 'CHECK' AS bizType, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(sci.diff_qty)), 0) AS lossQty, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(sci.diff_amount)), 0) AS lossAmount FROM stock_check_item sci JOIN stock_check_order sco ON sco.id = sci.order_id JOIN goods g ON g.id = sci.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE sco.status = 'AUDITED' AND sci.diff_qty < 0 AND sco.audit_time >= #{beginTime} AND sco.audit_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY sci.goods_id, g.name, c.name

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.cost_amount) FROM inventory i), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ir.change_qty * ir.unit_cost) FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.operate_time >= #{beginTime} AND ir.operate_time < #{endTime}), 0)
